experiment: Recency / marked-temporal-set test (token-specific timing beyond order)
hypothesis: Precursors are permutation-invariant but temporally localized: token-specific recency carries signal even though order does not.
verdict: NEGATIVE on real traces (after length-matched validation).
preregistered_win_condition: recency_value > +0.03 on >=2 REAL traces below the 0.082 order-injection floor -- NOT MET (only synthetic Azure clears it).
confound_found: Generic proximity [window_span, time-since-last-event] scores AUROC 0.73-0.97 even at fixed event count (n_events==K). The raw P+R gain is dominated by generic recency (measurement/window-boundary timing), not token-specific physiology. The stratified recency-null removes it; token-timing is then null on real traces.
refined_message: Not only is ORDER absent (Exp 1), token-specific fine TIMING is also absent on real traces once generic proximity is controlled. The predictive content is almost purely event PRESENCE (which events). Hardens the pure-presence thesis; does NOT provide a positive temporal-structure discovery.
reconstruction_validation: per-window event-count reconstruction matched stored n_events exactly (Azure/Alibaba/Sepsis mismatch=0; Kelmarsh 11/1928 boundary ties).
